facts.text: Bayesian beta-binomial analysis allows prior evidence, such as simulation results, to be formally combined with physical tests.
facts.quote: Bayesian beta-binomial analysis lets prior evidence (for example simulation results) be combined formally with physical tests.

facts.text: When combining prior evidence with physical tests using Bayesian analysis, expect challenges to the prior and use conservative Bayesian methods.
facts.quote: Expect challenge to the prior and use conservative Bayesian methods.

facts.text: A conservative Bayesian analysis of autonomous-vehicle road testing by Zhao, Robu, Flynn, Salako and Strigini at ISSRE 2019 found large sensitivity to the prior.
facts.quote: The sensitivity is large: a conservative Bayesian analysis of autonomous-vehicle road testing (Zhao, Robu, Flynn, Salako and Strigini, ISSRE 2019)

facts.text: The ISSRE 2019 conservative Bayesian analysis of autonomous-vehicle road testing found that a strong prior with 90% prior confidence reduces RAND's 275 million fatality-free miles to 69 million.
facts.quote: a strong prior (90% prior confidence) cuts RAND's 275 million fatality-free miles to 69 million

facts.text: The ISSRE 2019 conservative Bayesian analysis of autonomous-vehicle road testing found that a weak prior raises RAND's 275 million fatality-free miles to 476 million.
facts.quote: RAND's 275 million fatality-free miles to 69 million, while a weak prior raises it to 476 million.

facts.text: Sequential probability ratio tests allow testing to stop early when evidence is clearly good or clearly bad.
facts.quote: Sequential probability ratio tests allow stopping early when the evidence is clearly good or clearly bad

facts.text: Applying sequential probability ratio tests is attractive in a four-month validation window because testing can stop early when evidence is clearly good or clearly bad; this application is expert opinion.
facts.quote: Sequential probability ratio tests allow stopping early when the evidence is clearly good or clearly bad, which is attractive in a four-month window

facts.text: Stopping rules for sequential probability ratio tests must be fixed in advance.
facts.quote: the stopping rules must be fixed in advance.
